faqs.question: What does Home Insurance cover?
faqs.answer: Home Insurance protects the building structure and household contents against covered risks.

faqs.question: Does it cover natural disasters?
faqs.answer: Most comprehensive plans cover events such as floods, storms, earthquakes, and cyclones.

faqs.question: Does it cover theft?
faqs.answer: Theft coverage is generally available under comprehensive plans.

faqs.question: Can I insure only the building?
faqs.answer: Yes, building-only protection is commonly available.

faqs.question: Can I insure only household contents?
faqs.answer: Yes, contents-only coverage may be available.
